evidence_backed_direction.retained_construct: V5 Fresh Review verified alias-safe lm_head separation, complete embedding preservation, duplicate exact calibration capture, deterministic 169-tensor construction, 169/169 strict activation-energy-weighted improvement, and legal Dynamic Scale32 execution at all 312 activation boundaries.
evidence_backed_direction.measured_failure: Exact non-evaluator identity moved from V3 3/8 to V4 2/8 and V5 1/8 even though V4 improved unweighted reconstruction for all 169 tensors and V5 improved the diagonal activation-energy-weighted objective for all 169 tensors. V5 also worsened unweighted BF16 SSE from 2387.058149454451 to 2405.7241206996073. Unweighted weight SSE and a diagonal activation-energy detector are therefore both insufficient for the exact-sequence objective.
evidence_backed_direction.replacement_hypothesis: Retain the exact V4/V5 W4A8 product format, but capture visible calibration-derived within-block input covariance and use deterministic second-order error feedback. The block quadratic objective preserves cross-channel cancellation and sensitivity that V5's independent H_j terms discard, while adding no runtime metadata.
evidence_backed_direction.distinctness: V6 uses exact 16-channel Gram blocks, deterministic damped block solves, and sequential error propagation. V5 used only the diagonal sum(x_j^2) and independently reconstructed each weight under a separable objective. V6 is not a replay, parameter tweak, wider payload, sparse exception table, prompt-specific runtime policy, or repair under the V5 candidate ID.

calibration_covariance.permitted_model: pinned BF16 source model before any weight or activation quantization
calibration_covariance.permitted_positions: all prompt-prefill positions and deterministic BF16 greedy rollout through at most six generated tokens for the four frozen calibration prompts
calibration_covariance.block_partition: contiguous increasing input-channel blocks; the final block may contain 1 through 15 channels
calibration_covariance.statistic: For each Linear input block, convert every finite BF16 activation vector to one exact common dyadic integer lattice and accumulate the complete symmetric Gram matrix G=sum(x*x^T) with exact integer products and sums.
calibration_covariance.normalization: Divide all entries of one Gram block by their joint greatest common divisor only. Do not clip, percentile-scale, prompt-weight, whiten, use floating-point accumulation, or discard off-diagonal entries.
calibration_covariance.solve_damping: For factorization only, use Gd=G+lambda*I where lambda=max(1,ceil(trace(G)/(1000*n))) on the normalized integer lattice and n is the live block width. Eligibility objectives use undamped G.
calibration_covariance.required_identity: Two independent captures must produce byte-identical Gram blocks, prompt token hashes, BF16 generated calibration token arrays, position counts, and aggregate manifests for all 169 Linear modules.

candidate_state_construction.initial_invariant: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter object and storage immediately after pinned-model load
candidate_state_construction.separation_rule: Before construction, replace only lm_head.weight with a detached byte-identical non-trainable clone and set only the in-memory candidate configuration tie_word_embeddings field to false.
candidate_state_construction.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linear weights plus the separated lm_head weight
candidate_state_construction.post_quantization_embedding_invariant: The original embedding Parameter object, storage pointer, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 byte stream remain unchanged.

weight_policy.packing: row-major output row then input lane; even flat index in low nibble and odd flat index in high nibble

row_scale.format: existing normalized unsigned-Q1.15 Scale32 significand plus signed exponent record

block_covariance_error_feedback_algorith.data_source: pinned BF16 weights plus the frozen exact calibration Gram blocks only
block_covariance_error_feedback_algorith.initial_state: Freshly recompute the complete V4 eight-iteration unweighted joint row-Scale32/tensor-codebook result from pinned BF16 weights; do not import mutable V4 or V5 candidate state.
block_covariance_error_feedback_algorith.eligibility_objective: For each tensor, minimize sum over output rows and input blocks of e_block^T*G_block*e_block, where e=BF16_weight-decoded_weight and G is the undamped exact calibration Gram block.
block_covariance_error_feedback_algorith.error_feedback_assignment: Within each output row and 16-channel block, process input channels in increasing order. Quantize the compensated source coordinate to the nearest current row_scale*codepoint/16, with lower payload index on ties. Propagate its exact rational quantization error to later coordinates using the fixed increasing-order LDLT solve of Gd and the standard sequential inverse-Hessian ratio; reduce every rational by gcd and fail on a zero or negative pivot.
block_covariance_error_feedback_algorith.row_scale_update: With payload indices and codepoints fixed, form the exact full-block quadratic in one positive row scale, including all off-diagonal Gram terms. Evaluate legal Scale32 records bracketing the constrained dyadic ideal, their immediate normalized-significand neighbors, and the prior record. Choose minimum undamped block objective, then smaller scale, then smaller packed record.
block_covariance_error_feedback_algorith.codebook_update: With payload and row scales fixed, sweep codepoint indices 0 through 15. For each index, form the exact full-block univariate quadratic including cross-terms with all currently fixed codepoints, evaluate every signed-Q4.4 value preserving strict order, and choose minimum objective then smaller signed value. Empty codepoint assignments retain the prior value.
block_covariance_error_feedback_algorith.iteration_acceptance: Recompute compensated assignments after each row-scale/codebook sweep. The exact undamped tensor objective may not increase after any outer sweep; execute all four sweeps even at a fixed point.

activation_policy.payload: signed A8 symmetric range -127 through +127 with -128 reserved
activation_policy.base_record_source: the same frozen authenticated activation Scale32 significands used by V4 and V5
activation_policy.selection_rule: For each live finite group, preserve the base significand and choose the minimum integer exponent delta in [-24,+24] whose effective exponent remains in [-24,+4] and covers every lane without saturation.
activation_policy.failure_rule: If no legal delta covers a finite group, fail closed; never clip, saturate, or emit reserved -128.

accelerator_facing_format.weight_payload_transport: existing 128-bit external-memory read channel and existing packed 4-bit payload byte count
accelerator_facing_format.row_scale_transport: existing one 32-bit Scale32 record per output row
accelerator_facing_format.codebook_transport: one aligned 128-bit read beat per Linear tensor before its weight stream
accelerator_facing_format.compute_primitive: signed A8 activation multiplied by signed Q4.4 codepoint, integer accumulation, row Scale32 application, fixed fractional shift four

pre_attempt_closure.covariance_gate: Two independent exact BF16 captures over the four frozen calibration prompts must produce byte-identical full 16-channel Gram blocks, token arrays, position counts, and manifests for all 169 Linear modules.
pre_attempt_closure.model_gate: All 169 tensors must be non-regressing against a freshly reconstructed V4 candidate under the exact undamped block-covariance objective, with strict aggregate improvement.
pre_attempt_closure.non_evaluator_quality_gate: The same frozen eight non-evaluator inputs must achieve 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching BF16 response-gate outcomes before an official marker; the four additional inputs remain construction-blind holdouts.
pre_attempt_closure.dynamic_gate: A fresh V6 candidate must cover all 312 named activation boundaries with legal deltas, zero saturation, zero clipping, and no reserved -128 payload.

pre_attempt_closure.failure_disposition: Preserve PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave the official attempt unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit for Fresh Review without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16

risk_register: Block covariance and error feedback are evidence-backed replacements for failed diagonal detectors, not proof of exact token identity; the 8/8 gate remains mandatory.
A 16-channel block approximation omits longer-range covariance and may still fail; that outcome must remain a no-go rather than trigger an official attempt.
Exact rational LDLT and error propagation increase preparation cost and must prove duplicate capture and construction identity.

Calibration covariance is build-time evidence only; runtime covariance state, prompt-dependent selection, wider payload, sparse exceptions, extra row records, or product metadata growth are forbidden.
Any accepted numerical policy still requires Manager stage advance before RTL agreement, focused regression, fresh tree-specific PPA, demo retargeting, or U280 work.
